label: On Docker Hub, and ready for Unraid Community Applications
changes: **The image is on Docker Hub too, as isputnikdotnet/isputnik.video.** Every release tag publishes the same image to ghcr.io and to Docker Hub, as isputnik.home's does, and the Docker Hub page shows this README under a description that says what the container is: an add-on for isputnik.home. Every public description now says so: the GitHub repository, the image, the Unraid template and its profile.

**Ready for Unraid Community Applications as isputnik-video.** The template now publishes port 4300 on the ordinary bridge network, so isputnik.home reaches the engine at the server's own address with nothing to create first; a shared Docker network or br0 with a fixed IP work as before. It sends the administrator to isputnik.home's Control panel → Settings → Apps for the pairing, where the secret is generated first and pasted into Gateway Secret, and it carries this change log, regenerated by `npm run changelog` on every release.

label: Quality for viewers away from home
changes: **Quality rungs.** The player's Quality menu in isputnik.home 4.78 asks this engine for Original, 1080p, 720p or 480p, made while the film plays; a film already smaller than the rung is sent as it is. Someone watching from outside the home network is held under the cap set in Settings → Video (up to 720p to start with), read from the gateway's network header, because a Blu-ray rip sent as it is needs more upload than a home link has.

label: Profiles keep their own history
changes: **Viewing profiles keep their own history.** Continue watching, watched marks and My list belong to the profile isputnik.home 4.76 forwards, the same on every TV and browser, so the cartoons stay out of the grown-ups' Continue watching.

label: Without Stremio
changes: **The Stremio add-on's routes are gone**, with the add-on itself in isputnik.home 4.74. An older home keeps working; the engine only stops answering on addresses nothing asks for any more.

label: Pictures for a film's parts
changes: **A film in several parts shows pictures for each part**: a part matched to an episode of a TV show on TMDB gets that episode's picture, name and description.
